attrs.text: far side = a bare git repository via git transport on the same machine (a separate git receive-pack process with its own durable ref store); NOT a network service, NOT a third party; process-level crash (effecting process killed) and node-level crash (BEAM SIGKILLed with no DETS write in flight — ampd syncs on every mutation); a kill DURING a DETS write is NOT measured
